data.title: Azerbaijan: TotalEnergies Announces Final Investment Decision for Absheron Full Field Development
data.description: TotalEnergies, in partnership with SOCAR and XRG, has approved the Final Investment Decision (FID) for the Full Field Development of the Absheron gas and condensate field in the Caspian Sea. TotalEnergies holds a 35% stake, with SOCAR and XRG holding 35% and 30% respectively. The field, situated 100 km southeast of Baku, contains around 140 billion cubic meters of recoverable gas reserves. The initial development phase will have a production capacity of 1.5 billion cubic meters per year. TotalEnergies' stock symbols are Paris:TTE, LSE:TTE, and NYSE:TTE.
